title: 街路ごみ箱
description: 雨よけフード、投入口、施錠式扉、独立した脚と通気スリットを備えた街路用ごみ箱。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: Outdoor litter cabinet with a rain hood, real deposit opening, keyed service door, individual feet and vent details. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
